verdict.rationale: Digits ships automations such as auto-booking and the Agentic Close, so a buyer could fairly ask whether those automations can be versioned, reviewed and rolled back. The pack documents none of that. The nearby evidence covers different things: route-based API versioning, a resettable developer demo instance, and transaction 'smart reviews', none of which version or roll back a user's automation logic.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
